name: Mukhyamantri Covid-19 Bal Seva Yojana
benefit:
> ***Financial Assistance:***

- Each child beneficiary receives ₹5,000/- per month deposited in a joint account until they turn 18.
- Guardian and child receive free monthly ration under National Food Security Act.

> ***Education Assistance:***

- School Education:

   1. Free education in government schools.
   1. Fees paid for RTE provision private schools.
   1. RTE reimbursement limit for ot
_eligibility_text:
1. The affected family should be a local resident of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The family should not be eligible to avail the benefits of Chief Minister Covid-19 Yodha Kalyan Yojana.
1. The deceased parents of the child beneficiary should not have been government servants or employees of a government undertaking who were eligible to receive pension under the old pension scheme.
1. Such boys/girls whose age is 21 years or less, but till the prescribed duration of graduation course, whichever is less and whose-

  - Parent has died from COVID-19 or
  - Parents have died earlier and their legal guardian has died due to Covid-19.
  - One of the parents has died in the past and now the other has died of Covid-19.
  - Only During from 01 March 2021 to 30 June 2021
